name: Rune pouch
description: 750 slayer points for a rune pouch

children.note: Points come from the fifth task on: Vannaka 8, Chaeldar 10, Nieve 12, Duradel 15, Konar 18 per task, more on every 10th, 50th and 100th task. Turael and Spria give none.

Bought from any Slayer master for 750 slayer points. Also from the Mage Training Arena (150 telekinetic, 150 graveyard, 1,500 enchantment and 200 alchemist pizazz points), or as a note for 75 Last Man Standing points.
